newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TECO Energy upgraded.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TECO Energy upgraded.

text.p: -- Oppenheimer said it raised its rating on TECO Energy Inc to market perform from underperform.
-- TECO was up 1/8 to 24-1/8 at midday.
-- Oppenheimer raised its 1996 earnings estimate for TECO to $1.68 a share from $1.65 a share. The firm expects TECO to earn $1.75 a share in 1997 and $1.85 a share in 1998.
-- sees TECO as a core utility holding for long-term utility investors.
-- expects to continue to raise the dividend by about five percent annually and maintain the payout at around 65 percent of earnings.
